visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Unchecked Exception for a Bad Argument
visualizerParams.problemDescription: setAge declares throws Exception for a plain invalid argument, forcing every caller to catch Exception. Throw IllegalArgumentException instead and catch only that. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: A caller bug (passing -1) is a programming error and belongs to the unchecked family. Catching the specific IllegalArgumentException instead of Exception avoids hiding unrelated failures.
